narrative_blocks: This certificate confirms that the digital photograph submitted by Jane Doe meets all official technical and biometric standards for passport and official identity documents.
The submitted digital image has been verified for dimensions, aspect ratio, recency, framing position, and lighting uniformity by automated image quality assurance.

cases.title: Digital Passport Photo Compliance Verification
cases.issuing_authority: HM Passport Office Digital Verification Service
narrative_blocks: Digital photo validation report generated for submission reference DP-2026-8849202.
CRITICAL SPECIFICATION FAILURE: The submitted image file failed mandatory dimensions and resolution validation checks.

defect_spec.description: The submitted digital photo failed physical and digital file requirements. Image dimensions are 30x40mm (below required 50x70mm standard), pixel resolution is 240x320 px (below minimum required threshold), and file size is 42 KB (below minimum 200 KB requirement).

mutation_details.pixel_resolution: Mutated from '1200 x 1680 px' to '240 x 320 px'

cases.title: Digital Passport Photo Compliance Verification
cases.issuing_authority: HM Passport Office Digital Verification Service
narrative_blocks: Digital photo validation report generated for submission reference DP-2026-8849203.
CRITICAL RECENCY FAILURE: The submitted photograph was taken more than 6 months prior to application submission.

defect_spec.description: The digital photo submitted by the applicant was taken on 2024-11-12, exceeding the maximum allowable age limit of 6 months. Verification against photographer receipt REC-2024-1112-102 confirms the capture date is non-compliant with recency guidelines.

mutation_details.photo_date_taken: Mutated from recent date within 6 months to '2024-11-12' (20 months old)
mutation_details.applicant_appearance_recency: Mutated to reflect capture date older than 6 months
mutation_details.photographer_receipt: Mutated to outdated receipt code REC-2024-1112-102

narrative_blocks: Digital photo validation report generated for submission reference DP-2026-8849204.
FRAMING AND COMPOSITION FAILURE: Facial measurements and positioning fail biometric compliance rules.

defect_spec.description: The face composition fails compliance standards: chin-to-crown measurement is 20mm (required range is 31mm–36mm), face position is tilted off-center toward upper right, and applicant has an unacceptable smiling facial expression showing teeth.

mutation_details.chin_to_crown_height: Mutated from compliant '34mm' to '20mm' (undersized face height)
mutation_details.face_framing_position: Mutated from 'Centered' to 'Off-center to upper right, head tilted 15 degrees'
mutation_details.facial_expression: Mutated from 'Neutral expression' to 'Broad smile showing teeth with eyes half-closed'

narrative_blocks: Digital photo validation report generated for submission reference DP-2026-8849205.

defect_spec.description: The digital photo failed lighting and background checks: background is dark patterned blue wallpaper instead of plain white/light gray, direct lighting creates uneven illumination with hot spots, and pronounced shadows and glare on glasses are present.
